record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. A simple phase's body is its specification in practice, so the Spec key still leads to what the phase must do.

## Counter-argument

Hiding Spec for simple phases makes the tab bar say truthfully which phases are structured.

payload.choice: A phase with no specification shows its phase body and constraints on the Spec tab and hides the Design and Evidence tabs

record.subject: simple-phase-spec-tab
